title: Where $100 at Costco really goes
sentence: Of every $100 spent at Costco, about $1.94 is left from the sale itself, and members add about $1.99 in fees, which is why about half of Costco's operating profit comes from the card.
source: Costco, Q4 and fiscal 2026 results, Form 8-K (Sep. 24, 2026): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000909832/000090983226000084/costex9918-k92426.htm
